desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, please find enclosed the copies of newspaper advertisements published on 27th August 2026, post electronic dispatch of the Notice and Annual Report of the 36th AGM of the Company, containing inter alia the details regarding 36th AGM, Remote e-Voting and e-Voting facility system.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed the specimen copy of letter being sent to the shareholders regarding the unclaimed dividends and relevant shares of the Company liable to be transferred to the IEPF.
